We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

**Technical Lead – Data Engineering**

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) | Bengaluru | 6+ Years**

**About the Role**
------------------

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) powers the data foundation behind analytics, experimentation, personalization, ML and critical business decisions across Myntra.**

**We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead – Data Engineering to build and evolve large-scale data processing, ETL and orchestration platforms, while helping shape the next generation of AI-native and agentic data engineering at Myntra.**

**This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring deep technical ownership—from architecture and production-quality code to performance optimization, troubleshooting and operational excellence.**

**The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Spark, SQL, ETL, workflow orchestration, data modeling and modern lakehouse architectures.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Large-Scale Batch Processing**

* **Design, build and optimize large-scale batch processing systems using Apache Spark, PySpark and Spark SQL.**
* **Build production-grade pipelines handling high-volume transformations, joins and aggregations.**
* **Apply deep understanding of Spark DAGs, stages, shuffles, partitioning, joins, caching, memory and query plans.**
* **Diagnose data skew, shuffles, memory pressure, inefficient joins and partitioning issues.**
* **Optimize execution time, compute utilization and cost.**
* **Build reusable Spark libraries, frameworks and engineering patterns.**

### **ETL & Data Pipeline Engineering**

* **Build reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment and publishing.**
* **Develop reusable pipeline frameworks and abstractions rather than one-off solutions.**
* **Design for incremental processing, backfills, retries, idempotency, dependencies and failure recovery.**
* **Ensure correctness, freshness, scalability and maintainability.**
* **Own pipelines from architecture development deployment production operations.**

### **Workflow Orchestration**

* **Design and operate large-scale workflows using Apache Airflow, Dagster or equivalent platforms.**
* **Orchestrate complex dependencies across Spark, SQL and data-processing workloads.**
* **Build reusable operators, components and orchestration patterns.**
* **Improve scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management and operational visibility.**
* **Build self-service capabilities for developing, deploying and operating data pipelines at scale.**

### **Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering**

* **Build and operate large-scale workloads on Databricks and Spark-based environments.**
* **Design lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet or equivalent technologies.**
* **Optimize partitioning, file sizing, compaction, metadata, Spark and SQL workloads for performance and cost.**
* **Build platform capabilities that simplify compute, storage and data consumption.**

### **SQL, dbt, Data Transformation & Data Modeling**

* **Develop and optimize complex production-grade SQL and Spark SQL transformations.**
* **Build modular transformation models using dbt or equivalent frameworks.**
* **Establish standards for SQL quality, testing, documentation and dependency management.**
* **Troubleshoot expensive queries using execution/query plans.**
* **Design scalable relational, dimensional and lakehouse data models.**
* **Apply fact/dimension modeling, star schemas, SCDs and incremental models where appropriate.**
* **Translate business and analytical requirements into reusable data models across raw, curated and consumption-ready layers.**

### **Agentic Data Engineering**

* **Build AI-native data engineering capabilities across the end-to-end pipeline lifecycle.**
* **Design AI-assisted workflows that translate requirements into data models, SQL/Spark transformations and executable pipelines.**
* **Build agents that understand schemas, metadata, lineage, business semantics and existing pipelines.**
* **Apply LLMs/agents to SQL and pipeline generation, code review, testing, documentation and optimization.**
* **Build intelligent Spark/SQL optimization and pipeline RCA using execution plans, job metrics, logs, dependencies and historical performance.**
* **Automate generation of data-quality checks, tests, documentation and lineage metadata.**
* **Build natural-language/semantic interfaces for data discovery and safe pipeline creation/modification.**
* **Integrate agents with Airflow/Dagster, dbt, Databricks, Spark and metadata/catalog platforms.**
* **Design human-in-the-loop controls, validation, guardrails and evaluations for AI-generated SQL, code and pipelines.**
* **Build reusable agent frameworks, tools and APIs, not isolated AI demos.**

### **Data Quality & Governance**

* **Embed data quality into pipelines with automated freshness, completeness, schema and consistency checks.**
* **Establish standards for metadata, ownership, lineage and discoverability.**
* **Integrate with Unity Catalog or equivalent governance/catalog platforms.**
* **Design controls for PII, access management, auditing and sensitive data.**
* **Ensure AI-generated and human-authored pipelines follow the same quality, security and governance standards.**

### **Reliability & Operational Excellence**

* **Own production health of critical pipelines and platform components.**
* **Monitor failures, SLAs, freshness, data quality, performance and cost.**
* **Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex incidents.**
* **Eliminate recurring operational problems through automation, platform improvements and intelligent tooling.**

### **Technical Leadership**

* **Remain deeply hands-on while providing technical direction.**
* **Lead architecture/design reviews and review Spark, Python and SQL implementations.**
* **Mentor engineers across Spark, ETL, SQL, data modeling and production engineering.**
* **Build reusable frameworks and engineering standards adopted across teams.**
* **Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering.**
* **Lead complex cross-team initiatives and influence architecture without direct authority.**

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **6+ years of hands-on Data Engineering / Software Engineering experience building production data systems at scale.**
* **Deep expertise in Apache Spark / PySpark, Spark SQL and Spark internals.**
* **Strong programming skills in Python, Java or Scala.**
* **Advanced SQL, query optimization and performance-debugging skills.**
* **Strong experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.**
* **Experience with Airflow, Dagster or equivalent orchestration platforms.**
* **Experience with Databricks or comparable Spark-based platforms.**
* **Experience with dbt or SQLMesh**
* **Strong understanding of data modeling and lakehouse architecture.**
* **Experience with Parquet, Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg.**

description:

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve, you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and IDC MarketScape, but what matters most is the work behind it. We deliver real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora® Platform.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the chance to make a real impact in a high growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.
  
  
Our mission is simple. End Cyber Risk. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT ARCTIC WOLF, YOU WILL:**

* Lead the engineering teams across site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout for our network security sensor platform.
* Own release criteria and rollout decisions for firmware, kernel, and service updates across our global sensor fleet, including staged rolling deployments and rollback calls.
* Drive fleet reliability targets, including availability, upgrade success rate, and data flow continuity, across multi region cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Oversee the physical lab environment, including build servers, power distribution units (PDUs), and virtualized test fleets, keeping lab configuration aligned with production.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines and automated test frameworks spanning unit, integration, simulation, and full physical system testing, and reduce flaky tests to improve signal quality.
* Partner with infrastructure and security teams on container orchestration, database management, and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, to support sensor telemetry and detection workflows.
* Build and maintain the runbooks, dashboards, and on-call processes that your team, solution engineers, and solution architects depend on during incident response.
* Mentor and grow a team of engineers, strengthening people management practices and cross functional partnership with solution engineering managers and solution architects.

**Experience and Requirements**  
  
**YOUR EXPERIENCE MIGHT LOOK LIKE:**

* 10- 15 yrs of experience which should include 5+ years in software engineering, including 2 or more years managing engineering teams.
* Hands on experience with test infrastructure, lab environments, and CI/CD pipelines, including debugging across physical and virtualized systems.
* A track record in release engineering and platform reliability, with experience improving release confidence across distributed systems.
* Experience operating services on AWS, including container orchestration and managed database administration.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, and of security protocols relevant to network security appliances.
* Experience managing or partnering closely with QA and DevOps functions, and comfort working alongside solution engineers and solution architects.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience producing runbooks, postmortems, and release notes that on-call engineers depend on.

**On-Camera Policy**  
  
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
  
  
**About Arctic Wolf**  
  
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021 to 2025), Best Places to Work, USA (2021 to 2025), Great Place to Work, Canada (2021 to 2024), Great Place to Work, UK (2024 to 2026), and Kununu Top Company, Germany (2024 to 2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**  
  
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that, by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk, we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.
  
  
We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
  
  
All India wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment, ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
  
  
**Security Requirements**

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high‑quality software through a combination of manual and automated testing practices. This role works closely with Development, Product, DevOps, and Delivery teams to validate functionality, improve test coverage, identify defects early, and continuously enhance the quality of products and platforms. The QE contributes to test strategy, builds automation frameworks, and helps foster a culture of quality throughout the engineering organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Strategy**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and Developers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and system behaviour.
* Participate in story refinement to ensure testability and clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and regression suites.
* Contribute to the overall QA strategy, including test coverage goals, automation priorities, and risk-based testing.

**Functional & Non‑Functional Testing**

* Implement functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Validate API responses, UI behaviour, workflows, and data integrity across environments.
* Perform non‑functional testing such as performance, usability, or basic security validation as needed.
* Ensure defects are clearly documented, reproducible, and communicated effectively.

**Test Automation Development**

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using modern automation frameworks.
* Create and execute automated regression tests for UI, API, and service layers.
* Partner with Developers and DevOps to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure automation provides meaningful value by reducing manual effort and enabling early defect detection.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with Developers to understand architecture, code changes, and risk areas.
* Collaborate with DevOps to ensure environments, data, and pipelines support effective testing.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies, defect triage, and release readiness activities.
* Drive improvements in test processes, tooling, automation, and engineering practices.
* Advocate for quality throughout the SDLC and promote shift‑left testing.

**Release & Production Support**

* Validate builds and deployments in test environments; provide go/no‑go input for releases.
* Assist in root cause analysis for production issues and contribute to long‑term fixes.

* 3+ years of experience in software testing or quality engineering.

SRE at Goldman Sachs combines software and systems engineering to build run, and maintain high performant, distributed, fault tolerant systems. As a SRE Engineer you will be filling a mission-critical role ensuring that our systems are healthy, monitored, automated, and designed to scale. You will collaborate with engineering teams to continually improve our production services, facilitating fast delivery of new services, and reducing downtime. SRE utilizes automation, tools and solid engineering principles to optimize existing systems, build infrastructure and eliminate operational work. We are looking for passionate, curious, driven engineers who thrive on solving operational problems and improving efficiency and would like to apply their skills to Compliance Engineering SRE.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Proactive management of our production services by measuring and monitoring availability, capacity and overall system health.
* Shaping software before go-live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Scaling and evolving systems by pushing for changes that improve capacity and reliability.
* Practicing sustainable incident management in a blameless postmortem culture.
* Identifying and building improvements to system behavior, control and monitoring tools.
* Defining and maintaining Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to quantify and manage service reliability.
* Engineering solutions to reduce "toil" through advanced automation and self-healing system capabilities.
* Conducting capacity modeling and performance tuning to ensure systems meet future demand.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python and Perl.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly express ideas and arguments.
* Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with appreciation of technical risk.
* Experience with automated testing and SDLC concepts, developing applications in a Linux environment, and sound knowledge of algorithms, data structures and software design.
* Systematic problem-solving approach and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Ability to debug and optimize code and to automate routine tasks.
* Proficiency with Observability stacks, including distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry).
* Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
* Knowledge of networking protocols and load balancing strategies in a distributed systems environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field that involves programming.
* Experience in some of the following is desired: SRE experience, relational databases, Hadoop and big data technologies, knowledge of the financial industry or compliance/risk functions.
* Experience with Chaos Engineering principles and fault-injection testing to verify system resilience.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architecture and managed services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Understanding of Error Budgeting and its application in balancing feature velocity with system stability.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

* Passionate about solving operational problems and constant improvement via automation.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.

This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.

To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer's business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.

**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it's Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world's data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we're proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses.

*For candidates residing in California, please see our* *California Recruitment Privacy Notice**. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our* *EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.*

Digit88 is an AI-native product engineering partner helping startups and enterprises build, scale and operate intelligent software products.

We are a lean, high-impact team of 75+ technologists, backed by leaders with deep experience across startups and global enterprises. We build strong, outcome-driven engineering teams that solve complex, real-world problems.

With 80+ AI implementations and proven success in scaling dedicated teams and driving significant cost efficiencies, we partner for long-term impact.

We bring experience across B2B and B2C SaaS, web and mobile platforms, e-commerce and domains such as Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering - thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.

**The Vision:**

To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide, delivering ownership, speed, and measurable outcomes.

**Job Profile:**

Digit88 is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who works directly with customers to discover problems, design solutions, write production-quality code, build integrations, debug issues and drive deployment of Conversational AI and customer experience applications. The FDE owns outcomes from discovery through production and must be able to code, troubleshoot and explain technical trade-offs to customer and engineering stakeholders.

Java backend engineering and Python-based AI engineering are mandatory. Conversational AI experience is a must. Consumer-facing CCaaS experience across messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI is a major advantage because this role requires credible customer-facing subject-matter expertise.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with customer product, engineering, operations and customer experience teams to understand workflows, pain points, success metrics and technical constraints.

* Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Java and Spring Boot for customer-facing and platform workflows.

* Integrations and AI workflows are reliable, secure, observable and maintainable.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.

### **What Will You Do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

### **Why SentinelOne?**

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

title: DATA ARCHITECT
description:
Lead the architecture, design and deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, ML and deep learning solutions end to end: data pipelines, retrieval, agent orchestration, model serving, evaluation and monitoring on AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI and Databricks.

**Roles & Responsibility:**
---------------------------

**Solution Architecture**
-------------------------

* Own and lead the enterprise AI reference architecture and end-to-end design for Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, covering data ingestion, retrieval, orchestration, model serving, security, and monitoring.
* Select the optimal models, platforms, and architectural patterns across AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Databricks, balancing accuracy, latency, scalability, cost, and compliance requirements.
* Develop architecture blueprints, reference designs, and technical decision records (TDRs).
* Lead architecture reviews and establish engineering, security, and coding standards for AI solution delivery.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**
------------------------------

* Design and implement multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, and Amazon Bedrock Agents.
* Build enterprise-grade RAG solutions leveraging chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search, semantic search, re-ranking, and vector databases.
* Implement prompt engineering, guardrails, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Establish LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt versioning, groundedness validation, tracing, monitoring, and cost optimization.

**Data Science, Machine Learning & Deep Learning**
--------------------------------------------------

* Develop machine learning and deep learning solutions for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, optimization, NLP, and predictive analytics.
* Build scalable data and feature engineering pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow.
* Deploy AI models and intelligent agents as scalable APIs using FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Must Have**

title: Staff Engineer - Cross Border, Mercari India
description:
About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

**Bold Challenges**

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**  
Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Mercari's JP marketplace domain and internal platforms.
* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

  
**Benefits**

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

Owned Media

* Mercari Engineering Portal
* Mercari Engineering Blog: Backend
* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

Learn about XB and the Global App

* Building one global app platform (XB tech blog)

Related Articles

* Mercari Careers
* Culture Doc, the internal document that summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its members

title: Video & Data Core NOC Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Video & Data Core NOC Engineer to join our INOC team in Bangalore, supporting Vodafone’s Video and Data Core services within a 24x7 Network Operations Centre environment. This role is ideal for individuals with experience in telecom network operations who are passionate about ensuring network availability, monitoring service performance, identifying incidents, and supporting timely restoration activities. The successful candidate will contribute to the operational excellence of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G technologies while working closely with operational teams, suppliers and stakeholders.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Monitor Video and Data Core network alarms, events and service-impacting incidents across NOC platforms in a 24x7 operational environment.
* Perform first-level fault identification, incident validation, alarm correlation and initial troubleshooting activities.
* Manage incident handling activities including detection, impact assessment, prioritisation, tracking, escalation and closure.
* Raise, update and maintain trouble tickets with accurate documentation, impact analysis, actions taken and escalation status.
* Escalate unresolved incidents to L2/L3 teams, resolver groups, suppliers or vendors in accordance with agreed SLAs and operational procedures.
* Conduct routine shift activities, operational checks and network health monitoring.
* Support planned maintenance activities, post-change monitoring and service verification exercises.
* Operate and support Voice and Data Core networks and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G SA technologies, including native, VNF and containerised environments.
* Follow Vodafone operational procedures, security standards, governance requirements and incident management processes.
* Coordinate with internal support teams, field technicians, suppliers and external stakeholders to support service restoration activities.
* Review active alarms, incidents and pending tickets to ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
* Support inventory validation activities and report any discrepancies to relevant teams.
* Ensure compliance with site access procedures and operational controls during incident handling and resolution activities.
* Contribute towards achieving agreed operational KPIs and SLAs.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
* BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunications preferred.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in telecommunications network operations, preferably within a NOC or operational support environment.
* Understanding of GSM, UMTS, LTE and 5G Core technologies.
* Knowledge of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident management, fault handling, ticket management and escalation processes.
* Basic understanding of virtualisation technologies, VNF/CNF architectures and containerised network solutions.
* Ability to monitor alarms, correlate events, identify service impacts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills when working with internal teams, suppliers and external partners.
* Ability to perform effectively during major incidents and time-sensitive operational situations.
* Good written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear technical updates and incident reports.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts, including weekends, nights, public holidays and overtime when required.
* Secondary education completed.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work within a global telecom environment supporting critical Video and Data Core services.
* Exposure to advanced 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G Core network technologies.
* Experience working with virtualised and containerised telecom network platforms.
* Participation in major incident management and service restoration activities.
* Collaboration with international operational teams, suppliers and technical specialists.
* Development of operational expertise within a high-availability network environment.
* Exposure to industry-standard NOC operations, service management processes and network monitoring platforms.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced Network Operations Centre practices and operational governance.
* Incident lifecycle management aligned with ITIL methodologies.

The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization’s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI.

**Responsibilities**

* Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics.

* Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct & optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis & troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams & Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets.

* Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers.

* Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance).

* Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement).

* Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

* Strong understanding of data lineage, metadata traceability, and impact analysis.

* Experience applying governance-by-design and data observability (data quality tests, lineage, and certified datasets).

* Effective communication skills with ability to work directly with business stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

* 5+ years of analytics engineering, BI/data warehouse development, or related data experience in enterprise data environments.

* Preferred: Experience in professional services, accounting industry, or client service/consultative technology roles.

* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, dbt).

* Experience with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).

* Experience with data modeling methodologies (Dimensional modeling, Data Marts, Data Warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema).

description:

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

  

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

As a Managed Services Engineer II, you will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered solutions that support business and technology transformation. In this role, you will work across product, engineering, customer, and stakeholder teams to deliver scalable solutions from discovery and design through production rollout and post-go-live optimization. You will apply software engineering, systems integration, and AI capabilities to help solve complex business and technology challenges.

**Work you'll do**

As a Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

you will play a critical role in strengthening end-to-end visibility, reliability, and performance across cloud-native platforms. You will lead the migration from Elastic Stack (ELK) to Amazon Web Services (AWS) OpenSearch, ensuring a seamless transition of logging pipelines, dashboards, alerting strategies, and historical data retention. This includes redesigning ingestion flows, optimizing index structures, and improving query performance to enable scalable, real-time observability.

You will design and implement comprehensive observability solutions that help teams understand system behavior, accelerate troubleshooting, and make data-driven decisions. You’ll build and maintain robust monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks using modern tools and best practices—standardizing log formats, developing Grok patterns, defining index lifecycle management (ILM) policies, and ensuring efficient storage and search strategies that support both operational and business metrics.

You will also automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment pipelines using continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices to enable consistent, repeatable, and secure releases across environments. This work extends to Kubernetes and containerized workloads, where you will enhance visibility into cluster health, application performance, and distributed service interactions.

Collaboration is central to the role. You will work closely with development, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), and cloud engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and embed observability as a core engineering practice. You will mentor junior engineers and promote best-in-class standards, fostering proactive monitoring, fast incident response, and continuous improvement.

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. **Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad

* Experience migrating and creating visualizations, dashboards, rules, alerts, and triggers using GitHub pipelines.
* Experience automating snapshot backup and restore to OpenSearch using pipelines.
* Expertise in log management, Grok patterns, ILM policies, and Query DSL.
* Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.
* Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), and cloud security best practices.
* CI/CD pipeline development using GitHub Actions.
* Proven leadership in large-scale infrastructure migrations.
* Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:

* Experience with application performance monitoring (APM) tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus).
* SRE/DevOps mindset with incident management exposure.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
* Experience with Nginx (reverse proxying, load balancing, performance tuning).
* Knowledge of WebLogic administration, deployment automation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with service-oriented architecture (SOA) concepts, integration patterns, and legacy modernization.

title: GTM Data Quality Analyst
description:
**Location**
------------

Bengaluru

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**

Hybrid

--------------

Business Expansion

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You'll own the quality of the data that underpins every routing rule, territory, forecast and ARR number at CodeRabbit. You'll start by working the requests our GTM and Finance teams send to RevOps every day, and you'll turn each kind of request into a written runbook. Then you'll build the Data Quality Agent: an AI agent that handles most of those requests itself, routes the risky ones to a human for approval, and keeps a full record of everything it does. You'll join Business Systems, a small team that builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll work on the same engineering harness our engineers use to ship Salesforce and internal tool changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the tier-1 data queue for internal GTM systems data support: account ownership changes, account creation, merges, parent-child hierarchies, lead conversion, and linking billing subscriptions to the right Salesforce account.
* Resolve requests within the team's response standard and leave a record any teammate can pick up.
* Write and maintain a runbook for every recurring request type: the trigger, the checks, the steps, the edge cases, and when to escalate.
* Design, build and run the Data Quality Agent with Code Rabbit Coding Agent and our engineering harness, starting in shadow mode and earning its autonomy one workflow type at a time.
* Define the agent's approval tiers: what it can fix on its own, what it proposes for human approval, and what it always escalates.
* Run duplicate detection and merge cohorts across accounts, contacts and leads, and keep account hierarchies accurate as customers grow, merge and reorganize.
* Close enrichment gaps (firmographics, domains, HQ location, parent company) using our enrichment tools and the data warehouse.
* Track the request queue and data health with clear metrics: volume by request type, time to resolve, agent accuracy, and how often humans override the agent.
* Find the root cause behind repeat requests and bring proposals to the engineers so the fix lands upstream.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years in CRM data operations, sales operations, RevOps or data quality at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity data model, ownership and sharing basics, reports, and bulk data tools.
* Strong SQL. You can answer your own questions from the warehouse without waiting on an analyst.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate real work, and you can show us something you built: a prompt chain, a script, an agent, or an automation that saved hours.
* You write clear, step-by-step documentation that someone else can follow without asking you questions.
* Careful judgment with production data. You know which changes are easy to undo and which are not, and you treat them differently.
* Comfortable working across time zones with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dedupe and merge tools such as Traction Complete, DemandTools, Cloudingo or Salesforce duplicate rules.
* Python or JavaScript scripting, Git, and comfort working in a code repository.
* Experience with enrichment and prospecting data tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Exposure to billing systems such as Chargebee, and how subscriptions can map to CRM data.
* Experience with BigQuery, dbt or another cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows: approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logs and evaluations.
* Familiarity with developer-tools or technical B2B SaaS go-to-market (GTM).

**Our Values**
--------------

  

* **Collaborative Humans**: Prioritizing collective intelligence

* **Fearless Innovators**: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

* **Persistent, Passionate Developers**: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

* **Impact-Driven Creators**: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

* **Rapid Learners and Un-learners**: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

**What We Offer**
=================

  

* Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

* Collaborative and innovative environment

* Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

* Professional development opportunities

To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

Location: Bengaluru

**Job Profile:** Senior Application Support Engineer

**Position details** **:**

We are seeking a highly motivated professional for the position of Application Support Engineer (L2/L3) for production applications within Information Technology Department under Systems Office for Asia.

The Senior Application Support Engineer is responsible for providing advanced production applications support across APAC region. The successful candidate will be part of a dynamic team that undertake Business-As-Usual responsibilities in supporting the bank’s application systems. This role plays a critical part in maintaining applications stability, performance and integrity of business-critical applications.

As a hands-on 2nd level resolver, the role investigates and resolves incidents and service requests across application, database, configuration, integration and environment layers, escalating code related issues to development teams where required.

The role supports day-to-day business operations, contributes to root-cause analysis, and identifies opportunities to improve monitoring, automation, and operational practices. Working collaboratively with technology and business stakeholders, the role helps strengthen service reliability and the quality of technology services provided to the business.

**Roles and Responsibilities** **:**

* Assist stakeholders through application support, which includes problem investigations, analysis, and troubleshooting user issues.
* Work closely with various application teams to ensure reliable application services through effective collaboration and communication.
* Coordinate with multiple teams to raise support tickets, analyzing root causes following incidents, and resolving all production issues.
* Actively identifying opportunities to innovate, automate and improve operational efficiency.
* Troubleshooting and resolving application issues in accordance with SLAs, including database querying, data analysis, and issue resolution.
* Monitor alerts and incidents affecting the production environment and escalate as necessary.
* Possessing strong technical understanding of system platforms such as UNIX, Windows, and Oracle, providing support during investigations.
* Implement and manage automation processes with an aim to reduce manual tasks and enhance efficiency.
* Performing initial technical analysis by reviewing logs, error messages, database records, configuration changes and recent deployments to identify probable causes before escalating to development teams.

* Providing round-the-clock (24/7) operational support for production systems, including on weekends and holidays.

* Utilize development experience to contribute to production projects, optimizations, and initiatives to solve problems.
Demonstrate the capacity to work across diverse geographical locations, time zones, cultures, and technical environments.

* Proficiency in automation tools, monitoring tools, and scripting would be a plus point.

* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk or equivalent platforms.

* Prior experience in managing production applications and servers.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

A total of 10 to 14 years of relevant work experience is required for this role.

------------

  

**Standard**  

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

------------------

  


As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering in our Risk, Group Technology team, you will operate as a hands\-on partner to Senior Managers, Risk Managers, and fellow Associates to deliver decision\-useful monitoring and automation across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes.


You’ll combine hands\-on data analysis and evidence collation with governed automation and AI\-assisted drafting to improve timeliness, consistency and quality of insights.  

  

You’ll build, test and maintain prompt and retrieval patterns, co\-pilot agents and workflow automations using approved tooling (where authorised), while learning and



Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  


**Role Type: Permanent**  

**Role Location: Bengaluru**  

**Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

  

As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering, you will:

  


* Supporting delivery of the insights plan by translating priority insight routines into a practical delivery backlog of automation and  

agent use\-cases (as agreed with the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights)
* Working with Risk Officers and SMEs to capture repeatable workflows (report refreshes, evidence collation, control attestations,issues tracking) and translating them into clear automation/agent requirements with agreed acceptance criteria
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely,trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk\-in\-change and remediation progress
* Building and maintaining workflow automations (data extraction, transformation, scheduling, approvals and notifications) to improve timeliness, reduce manual effort and increase consistency of risk reporting and insight delivery
* Supporting integration with existing platforms (reporting datasets, SharePoint/Teams and risk tooling) and contributing to userguidance and adoption (how\-to guides, training snippets, support triage and continuous improvement)
* Coordinating with Technology, Cyber, Risk, Data and Internal Audit stakeholders on analytics, automation and agent use\-cases,definitions, thresholds and evidence expectations to improve consistency and reduce duplication
* Continuously improving templates, automations and agent behaviours to increase consistency, timeliness and decisionusefulness;documenting lessons learned and maintaining a clear change log of updates
* Supporting uplift tracking (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by automating evidence collation and improving repeatability of reporting outputs
* Operating as a hands\-on specialist, demonstrating strong documentation and quality discipline so automations and agents are safe, repeatable and supportable
**What will you bring?**
------------------------

  

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  


* Experience in automation, engineering delivery, analytics engineering, risk analytics or a similar role, with evidence of delivering workflow solutions used by business teams
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and building AI\-assisted workflows/agents using approved tooling (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem) including evaluation, guardrails and iteration based on user feedback
* Strong data skills: ability to work with structured and semi\-structured data, define data quality checks and build reliable refresh pipelines for recurring reporting (e.g., SQL and data wrangling)
* Experience with workflow automation and integration tooling (e.g., Power Automate), scripting (Python preferred) and/or APIs, plus strong documentation and runbook discipline
* Experience delivering solutions for Technology Risk, Cyber Risk, Operational Risk or governance/reporting teams within Financial Services
* Working understanding of risk and control concepts (e.g., technology/cyber risk, operational risk, issues/incidents, control testing) and the ability to translate policy/standards into practical checks within an agent or workflow
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills: ability to capture pain points, prototype solutions and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes; comfortable taking guidance and escalating risks and blockers early
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
